metas.name: Bluey
metas.description: This show hilariously and endearingly depicts the imaginative play and family dynamics of a young Blue Heeler pup, offering relatable moments for both kids and parents.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Building on the legacy of Mister Rogers' Neighborhood, this animated series teaches social-emotional skills and problem-solving in a gentle and musical way.

metas.name: Paw Patrol
metas.description: A team of rescue pups with unique skills works together to save the day in Adventure Bay, promoting teamwork and problem-solving.

metas.name: Doc McStuffins
metas.description: A young girl who can talk to her toys helps them when they're sick, teaching empathy and basic health concepts.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Two brothers travel the world on amazing adventures to learn about animals and their habitats, sparking curiosity about wildlife.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: A team of undersea adventurers explores the ocean and rescues marine creatures, introducing oceanography and conservation.

metas.name: Curious George
metas.description: This series follows the adventures of an inquisitive young monkey and the Man with the Yellow Hat, encouraging exploration and discovery.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Four fairy tale characters use the power of literacy to solve problems, helping young viewers learn to read and understand stories.

metas.name: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
metas.description: Ms. Frizzle's adventurous class takes educational field trips on a magical bus, exploring science concepts in fun and engaging ways.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A gentle and beautifully animated series that follows a small fox named Fig and his friends as they explore their world and learn through play and discovery.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: These animated robots answer kids' big questions about the world, making learning fun and energetic with catchy songs and humor.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: This beautifully animated Irish show follows Oona and Baba, two young puffins, as they explore their island home and learn about nature and friendship.

metas.name: Sarah & Duck
metas.description: A gentle and whimsical show about a curious girl named Sarah and her adopted duck, exploring everyday wonders and imaginative scenarios.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: This animated show follows an Alaskan Native girl and her family, celebrating Indigenous culture and teaching about community and problem-solving.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: Xavier and his friends travel back in time to meet famous historical figures and learn important life lessons.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: This animated series follows a spirited Dominican-American girl from the Bronx who helps her family and community solve problems with her unique perspective.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: The iconic Cat in the Hat takes kids on science adventures, answering their questions about the world around them.

metas.name: Peg + Cat
metas.description: A girl and her feline sidekick solve problems using math and creative thinking, making numbers and shapes fun.

metas.name: StoryBots Super Songs
metas.description: A spin-off of Ask the StoryBots, focusing on educational songs covering a wide range of topics for young learners.

metas.name: Esme & Roy
metas.description: This show features two friendly monster nannies who help young monsters overcome their challenges through imaginative play and problem-solving.

metas.name: Go Jetters
metas.description: Four young explorers travel the world with their mentor, Grandmaster Glitch, learning about geography and landmarks.

metas.name: Creative Galaxy
metas.description: A young artist named Arty helps solve creative problems across the galaxy, encouraging imagination and artistic expression.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Based on the beloved book series, this show follows the adventures of a boy and a very persistent mouse, teaching about cause and effect.

metas.name: Hello Ninja
metas.description: This series follows a young boy who discovers he has a superpower and learns about mindfulness and problem-solving with the help of his ninja grandpa.

metas.name: Pinky Dinky Doo
metas.description: A young girl who loves to make up stories uses her imagination to solve problems and navigate everyday situations.

metas.name: The Stinky & Dirty Show
metas.description: Two unlikely friends, a garbage truck and a backhoe loader, go on adventures and learn about problem-solving and friendship.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: Kids living in a neighborhood of scientists learn about space exploration and astronomy through fun adventures.

metas.name: Odd Squad
metas.description: A live-action show where kids solve math-related mysteries using their powers and teamwork.

metas.name: Elinor Wonders Why
metas.description: An observant bunny named Elinor encourages her friends to ask questions and explore the natural world around them.

metas.name: Rhyme Time Town
metas.description: Two characters, Cattogether and Dogget, solve problems in Rhyme Time Town by using their knowledge of rhymes and wordplay.

metas.name: Ollie & Moon Show
metas.description: A curious cat and his best friend go on adventures around the world, learning about different cultures and places.

metas.name: Gabby's Dollhouse
metas.description: A young girl enters a magical dollhouse world where she has adventures with her cat and friends, encouraging creativity and problem-solving.

metas.name: Numberblocks
metas.description: These animated characters bring numbers to life, helping children develop a foundational understanding of mathematics through engaging visuals and songs.

metas.name: Alphablocks
metas.description: Similar to Numberblocks, this series uses animated letter characters to teach children phonics and how to read.

metas.name: T.O.T.S.
metas.description: A group of adorable animals delivers baby animals to their new families, teaching about responsibility and care.

metas.name: Blippi
metas.description: An energetic and curious host takes young viewers on field trips to exciting places and teaches them about various topics in a fun, educational way.

metas.name: WordWorld
metas.description: Animated animals are made up of letters that form their bodies, teaching children about words and spelling in a unique way.

metas.name: Sesame Street
metas.description: A long-standing educational program that uses muppets and animated segments to teach children about letters, numbers, and social-emotional skills.

metas.name: The Wiggles
metas.description: This Australian children's music group produces energetic and engaging shows with songs and dances that promote physical activity and learning for preschoolers.
